resolvedReport.dataSource: SELECT tblCase.CaseID, [Matter and AR].MatterID, [Matter and AR].Date2, [Matter and AR].Pay_Outlay, [Matter and AR].Charge, [Matter and AR].Payment, Nz([Charge],0)-Nz([payment],0) AS Balance, fncRunningDebit([tblcase].[CaseID],[Date2],[MatterID]) AS RunningDebit, fncRunningCredit([tblcase].[CaseID],[Date2],[MatterID]) AS RunningCredit, [RunningDebit]-[RunningCredit] AS RunningBalance, tblCase.Retainer, [RunningBalance]+[retainer] AS RetBal FROM tblCase INNER JOIN [Matter and AR] ON tblCase.CaseID = [Matter and AR].CaseID ORDER BY [Matter and AR].MatterID;
